title: iwrote: show you wrote it. Certify your writing as human
excerpt: Write in your browser and iwrote records how the words arrive. Certify the piece and get a link that shows readers how you wrote it, not an AI detector's guess.
content_html:
Write the way you always do. Read, research, brainstorm with AI, fix your grammar: AI is your tool, not your writer. iwrote keeps the counts, never the words, and if you wrote it yourself, certifies it under your name. Human writing, for human reading.
